reviews.title: Excellent app for a bargain price!
reviews.contents:
I purchased the PBC Digital Pack and found it amazingly helpful and informative so I was really excited when I heard about this app and immediately purchased it too. I am not at all disappointed and it has all the features that I could wish for. I haven’t used it for labour yet as I’m due in a couple of weeks but, having played around with it, I’m pleased that it seems really easy to use and navigate your way around, a must for in the midst of labour! I like it so much that we actually purchased it twice, both on my phone and on my husband’s. 
I love that you can choose to have the background music on or off and that the up-breathing counting can be changed from 4-8 to 3-6. I also like the fact that you can easily change the mp3 tracks that you listen to between surges and there is a good selection of positive affirmations and relaxation scripts so things hopefully won’t become repetitive during a longer labour. 
The timer seems v easy to use whilst experiencing a surge as the place to press on the screen is large and can’t really be missed and I imagine that the expanding circle will give me something to focus on as a distraction. I also think this will be a great reassurance of when to contact the hospital. 
I am really impressed by this app and think it’s an absolute bargain for the price. I also love the PBC so much that I have also just purchased the postpartum pack! If you haven’t already, but the packs as well!

reviews.title: Best hypnobirth and surges times I’ve ever seen
reviews.contents:
I finished the Hypnobirth course from The positive company a few weeks ago (and I recommend it with all my heart by the way) and a big part of it is practicing the relaxation (before and during labour) and using the breathing during labour.
I was a bit worried about the “logistics” in birth, how I would count the surges and do the breathing techniques, as well as the relaxation bits too… the materials are a kind of a guide, but not very easy to access when you are in labour I guess.
I absolutely loved this app!!!!  It was such a great idea and great execution! They managed to combine the surges timer with a relaxation/visualization track and guided breathing!! All in one place, without having to tap millions of buttons, you just need to put your headphones and listen to it, and of course, when you are in labour, tap when your surges comes and goes. Its all there and very easy to use.
And the design…. OMG! Its absolutely gorgeous. Its simple, intuitive, the colors are amazing… I’m just in love with the whole thing. 
And I’m here sitting in my desk, working and listening to it right now. It is totally worth paying for and better than any app of this kind I’ve ever tried. Freya will be my second birth partner. ❤️

reviews.title: Perfect companion for hypnobirthing
reviews.contents:
This app is brilliant if you’ve done any kind of hypnobirthing course. I’ve done the Positive Birth Company digital pack and would strongly recommend this as the perfect companion to that course (as well as the course itself!).

First of all, it’s a beautiful app, with gorgeous soothing colours and graphics. As for features, it has everything you could want to support your hypnobirthing journey. You can track your surges with flexible counting options to help with your breathing and there are some great guided relaxations and affirmations to help you relax in between. This latest version gives you more control over the audio you can listen to - making it easier to familiarise yourself in preparation for the big day (a super important part of the course is practice!) and so you can select the perfect relaxation for you in the moment when the time comes. It’s also really helpful that it lets you know when you’ve reached established labour.

My baby is due to arrive in a few weeks’ time and know that this will be a massive help to track my surges and keep me as calm and relaxed as possible for a beautiful birth.

reviews.title: A wonderful app and my ‘stand-in’ birth partner for early labour!
reviews.contents: I was awaiting a planned C-Section for my breech baby when I went into labour on the pre-natal ward during the night. Due to COVID-19 I didn’t have my birth partner with me on the ward and, although the midwives were monitoring me frequently, I was managing the contractions on my own. The Freya app was my absolute saviour! I put my headphones on and listened to the mediations, using the timer feature and listening to Siobhan’s counting every time I had a contraction. The timer function was so so helpful because I couldn’t time the contractions myself as I was too focused on breathing through them. I could just show the midwives my phone and they could clearly see I was having 3 in 10. Eventually I stopped listening to the mediations because of lots of people coming in and out to monitor me and talk through next steps, so I just used the timer feature and watched the circles get bigger and smaller to show me when to breathe. I really think I would have been lost without this app!

reviews.title: Everything you need in one app!
reviews.contents: I gave birth back in July and had the best birthing experience which I largely put down to the positive birthing company and the online hypnobirthing course. I listened to the positive affirmations at least once a day, especially to help me sleep at night. I’m a poor sleeper at the best of times but the affirmations and relaxations were my saviour, especially towards the end of pregnancy when getting comfortable was difficult to achieve. On the night I went into labour I was listening to the affirmations whilst timing my surges on my phone and writing down the length of them on a piece of paper as I hadn’t downloaded an app.  Outside of that I was 100% in the zone. Here you have everything you need to do all of that in one app. Without having to flip from one screen to another, someone doing the counting for you, allowing you to stay completely in your zone and in control. I love it and it will definitely be put to good use in the event of baby number two. Happy hypnobirthing!!!

reviews.title: Positive “life” company
reviews.contents:
Where to start? I’ve followed Siobhan since being introduced to her by watching the Michalaks and Louise Pentland, when I found out I was pregnant I felt insanely lucky as she was just about to release the PBC online course.. which both myself and my husband watched throughout my pregnancy. I had a WONDERFUL birth - even though it didn’t go “to plan” and I, 100%, believe this is down to the lessons we learnt. When this app was released, I’d already had my baby - but I downloaded it straight away... I just knew that it would come in handy one day and I that I needed to show my support to the woman behind the brand. 

I was lucky enough to meet Siobhan at a book signing - and I took along my bundle of joy along to meet her. I was so happy to find out that she is every bit as lovely in person as she is online... 🥰

I’m looking forward to using this app throughout my next labour and cannot wait to resign up to the online course. ❤️

reviews.title: Ideal for hypnobirthers!
reviews.contents:
This is the ideal accompaniment to hypnobirthing! The app consists of a surge timer which can track the length and few of your surges and tell you when would be a good time to call your midwife. While timing them you have Siobeann’s calming voice counting you through the “up” breathing with the calming expanding circle graphic. While surges are not happening you can listen to the guided relaxation tracks, or you can mute them. They come back in when your surge is over just where they left off 😊 you can clear all surges so practise before the big day is possible. No ads, beautifully simple, and having recently searched to see what other hypnobirthing apps are available and been very disappointed- this is head and shoulders above anything out there already. Thank you for creating it!!!! 
Ps. One tiny improvement would be to be able to select which relaxation track you want to listen to, but I’m only splitting hairs here!

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.contents:
I used the Freya app for the birth of my second, after a recommendation from a friend. Whilst I’d actually done a Hypnobirthing course in both pregnancies with another provider (simply because I hadn’t known about The Positive Birth Company!), it was exactly what I needed and totally complimentary to what I’d been practicing. It was on throughout pretty much my entire labour and I found using the counting button for breathing during the surges to be so incredibly useful for keeping me calm, focused and controlled especially when walking from the car to the delivery room. And the audio in between surges helped me relax and be ready for the next throughout the labour. 

I highly recommend the Freya app for practice during pregnancy and for the big day, and also recommend the PBC book and affirmation cards, which I also read and used throughout my second pregnancy after learning about them!

Thanks so much!

reviews.title: Preparing for birth
reviews.contents: I have downloaded this app after purchasing the positive birthing company pack. I am currently 38 weeks pregnant and will be using this app in the near future. I have trialled the app to get a feel of how to use it whilst in labour and am amazed at all the different aspects and how easy it is to navigate. After watching the positive birthing company videos i love Siobhans calming voice and the addition of music in the background, however I also find it great that the sound can be turned off whilst also tracking the length of surges. I showed my husband how to use it incase I do not want to use my phone whilst in labour and he also found it very easy to navigate. The settings section allows you to clear the surges, turn off the music and to adjust the breathing pattern or turn off the counting audio. I found those very useful but it may be different whilst birthing my baby, so It’s great that these features can be turned off.

reviews.title: Freya Surge Timer
reviews.contents:
I am absolutely delighted with this app. I recently purchased the Positive Birth Company digital pack with the intention of using the guidance and methods contained to help me through labour and delivery. Freya is a perfect accompaniment to the lessons learnt and would be a worthwhile purchase even without prior knowledge of the course.

The design of the app is beautiful and the colours are calm and serene. It’s extremely user-friendly and easy to navigate, something that I’m sure will be appreciated during labour when the last thing you’re going to want is to take too much attention away from your breathing.

I’m particularly thankful for the inclusion of the guided meditations I already know from the course. These are familiar and have been well-practiced. They are a comforting addition alongside the surge timer itself. I especially like that the timer ‘interrupts’ the reading with audible breathing guidance once clicked, picking right back up with the track once your surge has ended. The transition is seamless and very much appreciated.

You’re also able to clear your surge history and personalise the experience further, picking and choosing which aspects will be beneficial to you. If you’re as particular as I am, I’m sure you’ll love it as much as I do. 

Overall, I’d recommend Freya highly for anybody looking to achieve a calm and gentle birth. Now that I’ve seen exactly what it’s got to offer, I couldn’t imagine going ahead into labour without it. I can’t wait to have Freya by my side when the time is right.
